 Dated this the 6th day of August, 2025  ORDER
This bail application is filed under section 483 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.1010 of 2024 of Ollur Police Station, Thrissur,
registered for the offences punishable under Sections 354D, 376(2)(n), 376(3), 506(1) and 201 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860, apart from Section 5(l) r/w Section 6(1), Section 11(iv) r/w Section 12 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, which is now pending as S.C.No.1429 of 2024 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court-II, Thrissur.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. According to the prosecution, the accused had in April 2023, December 2023 and again on 01.01.2024 repeatedly committed penetrative sexual assault on the minor victim aged 15 years.
Petitioner was arrested on 04.10.2024, and he has been in custody since then.

4. Heard Sri. Biju C. Abraham, the learned Counsel for the petitioner as well as Sri. Noushad K. A.,
the learned Public Prosecutor.
Though notice to the victim has been served through the investigating 2025:KER:58754 officer, there is no appearance.
5. The learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that petitioner has been in judicial custody from 04.10.2024, and therefore, he ought to be released on bail.
6. The learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application and submitted that petitioner is involved in three other criminal cases.
7. Petitioner is only 21 years in age.
He is alleged to have committed penetrative sexual assault on a minor victim, aged 15 years at the time of incident.
Further, the final report has been filed, and the case is pending as S.C. No.1429 of 2024 on the files of the Fast Track Special Court -II, Thrissur.
Petitioner has been in custody for the last ten months.

8. Though the learned Public Prosecutor pointed out that there are three other crimes against the petitioner, of which one is under the POCSO Act, being against the same victim, since the other crimes are not serious in nature, those antecedents need not deter this Court from granting bail to the petitioner.
Having regard to the period of custody already undergone by the petitioner, apart from the surrounding circumstances, I am of the view that further custody of the petitioner is not necessary.
9. Accordingly, the bail application is allowed on the 2025:KER:58754
following conditions:-

sentences.text:
(a) Petitioner shall be released on bail on him executing a bond for Rs.50,000/-
(Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the court having jurisdiction.
(b) Petitioner shall co-
operate with the trial of the case.
(c) Petitioner shall not intimidate or attempt to influence the witnesses; nor shall he tamper with the evidence or contact the victim or her family members.
(d) Petitioner shall not enter into the jurisdictional limits of the Police Station, where the victim resides, pending conclusion of trial.
(e) Petitioner shall not commit any similar offences while he is on bail.
(f) Petitioner shall not leave the State of Kerala without the permission of the Court having jurisdiction.

In case of violation of any of the above conditions or if any modification or deletion of the conditions are required, the jurisdictional Court shall be empowered to consider such applications, if any, and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, notwithstanding the bail having been granted by this Court.

Sd/-
BECHU KURIAN THOMAS JUDGE jka/06.08.25.
